title: Pay business operating expenses
summary: Software subscriptions, contractor labor, business insurance, professional services. Track every receipt for deductibility.
detailsHtml:
Deductibility

Most ordinary and necessary business expenses are fully deductible against business income on Schedule C, reducing both income tax and self-employment tax. This makes the effective after-tax cost of a business expense considerably lower than a personal expense.

Example: $1,000 business software subscription Federal tax savings (24% bracket): $240 SE tax savings (15.3%): $153 State tax savings (5%): $50 Total tax savings: $443 Effective after-tax cost: $557

This is also why "running personal expenses through the business" is a serious felony in the eyes of the IRS — the tax savings are real, and so are the penalties for fraud.
